evidence: The SiO /50–ZnO nanocomposite layer is about 130 nm thick. The refractive index of the SiO /50–ZnO nanocomposite layer is 1.52 as measured by the thin film measurement system, which is much smaller than that of the n-ZnO and p-GaN layers. The cross-sectional transmission electron microscopy (TEM) images reveals that small ZnO nanodots with diameters of 3–10 nm are dispersed uniformly in the amorphous SiO /50 layer.
